items.definition:
involving or characterized by deep thought
She spent a contemplative hour by the lake, reflecting on her day.

relating to geometry or geometric shapes
The artist used bold geometrical patterns in her design.

not able to be bent; unwilling to change or compromise
His inflexible attitude made negotiations difficult.

Of or relating to a prince; magnificent.
He received a princely sum for his services.

from the south
A strong southerly wind blew across the plains.

complaining in a high-pitched, irritating voice
The child became whiny when he was tired.

large in quantity; abundant
The harvest was bountiful this year.

unambiguous; explicit; absolute
He issued a categorical denial of the accusations.

having a tendency to cling to someone or something; excessively dependent
The child became very clingy when his mother left.

ready or eager to fight; aggressive
The politician became combative during the debate.

excessively proud of oneself; vain
His conceited attitude made him unpopular.

full of elaborate or ornate expressions
His speech was too flowery and difficult to understand.

not seeming reasonable or probable
Her excuse for being late was completely implausible.

localized (restricted to a particular area)
The pain was localized to her lower back.

Characterized by conceited assertiveness and dogmatism.
He's very opinionated and always has strong views on everything.

Resembling paste in consistency or color; (of a person's face) unhealthy pale.
After being sick, her face looked pale and pasty.

relating to radiology or radiation
The patient underwent a radiological examination.

(of a voice or sound) high-pitched and piercing
A shrill cry echoed through the night.

not investigated or explored
There are still many unexplored regions in the Amazon rainforest.

not sold
The store had a large quantity of unsold merchandise after the holidays.

anxiously nervous or tense; stiffly conventional
Don't be so uptight; just relax and enjoy the party.

causing anxiety or concern
The rising unemployment rate is a worrisome trend.

Acceptable or valid, especially as evidence in a court of law.
The judge ruled that the new evidence was admissible.

forming a climax
The climactic scene of the movie was very intense.

arousing envy
She has an enviable collection of rare books.

incapable of failure or misuse
The instructions were foolproof, even for a beginner.

relating to or involving different cultures
The company promotes intercultural understanding among its employees.

excellent or very good
Everything is just peachy, thanks for asking.

resembling a pearl in color or luster
She had a string of pearly white teeth.

able to be searched
The new database makes all documents easily searchable.

slightly drunk
After two glasses of wine, she started to feel a bit tipsy.

not disputed or questioned
His authority remained unchallenged throughout his career.

eager to shed blood; cruel
The villain in the story was a bloodthirsty tyrant.

noisy and energetic
The boisterous crowd cheered loudly for their team.

able to catch fire and burn easily
Gasoline is a highly combustible liquid.

damaging the good reputation of someone
The newspaper article contained several defamatory statements.

soft and sticky
The melted cheese was deliciously gooey.

feeling or showing anger or annoyance at what is perceived as unfair treatment
She was indignant at the unfair accusation.

unable to produce offspring or unable to support abundant plant growth
The infertile soil yielded no crops.

carefree; cheerful; not serious
She had a lighthearted approach to life, always finding joy.

of, involving, or absorbed in meditation or deep thought
He spent hours in a quiet, meditative state.

Situated on the outside of a boat or vehicle.
The small fishing boat was powered by an outboard motor.

Relating to or denoting any of a number of Christian movements that emphasize direct personal experience of God.
She attends a Pentecostal church every Sunday.

using money and other resources carefully and not wastefully
She is very thrifty and always looks for bargains.

existing, occurring, or used under the surface of the sea
They explored the undersea world with scuba gear.

not having been filtered
She gave her unfiltered opinion on the matter.

not opposed or resisted
The candidate ran unopposed in the election.

somewhat black; tending to black
The sky had a blackish hue before the storm.

difficult to carry out or fulfill; oppressive
The new regulations proved to be quite burdensome for small businesses.

(of an animal) feeding on other animals
Lions are carnivorous animals.

(of a person) suffering from claustrophobia; (of a place) inducing claustrophobia
The small, windowless room felt very claustrophobic.

feeling intense excitement and happiness
She felt euphoric after winning the championship.

easily influenced because of a lack of experience or maturity
Young children are often very impressionable.

having no money; very poor
After losing his job, he found himself penniless.

looking attractive in photographs
She's very photogenic; every picture of her looks great.

relating to a system in which input data is processed within milliseconds
The software provides real-time updates on stock prices.

untidy and disheveled
He looked a bit scruffy after sleeping on the train.

lively, energetic, or quick-witted
She has a very sparky personality.

able to be treated or cured
Fortunately, the condition is treatable with medication.

Not explained or missing.
Several items remain unaccounted for after the inventory.

Not requested or necessary.
His rude comment was completely uncalled for.

Not democratic; not based on democratic principles.
The decision was seen as undemocratic by many citizens.

Not punished.
It's unfair that the crime went unpunished.

Not acknowledged or identified.
His efforts went unrecognized for a long time.
